ohana: ohana only in cpd. bimbɔohana, see under bimba.
ohanati: ohanati [ava + han, but prob. a new formation from Pass. avahīyati of hā, taking it to han instead of the latter] to defecate, to empty the bowels PvA 268 (+ osajjati).
oharaṇa: oharaṇa (nt.) [fr. oharati] lit. "taking away", leading astray, side--track, deviating path J VI.525 (C.: gamana--magga). Cp. avaharaṇa.
oharati: oharati [o + hṛ take] -- 1. to take away, take down, take off S I.27 (ger. ohacca, v. l. ūhacca); Pv II.66 (imper. ohara = ohārehi PvA 95); DhA IV.56 (see ohārin). See also ava°. -- Caus. I. ohāreti (see avahārati); Caus. II. oharāpeti in meaning of oharati to take down, to cut or shave off (hair) J VI.52 (kesamassuṃ); DhA II.53 (cp. oropeti). -- pp. avahaṭa.
